facts.raw_span: erythematous, infiltrating, well-demarcated skin lesions located on the face, chest, abdomen, and limbs
Mycological culture yielded growth of Trichophyton mentagrophytes
Images showing inflammatory lesions on the abdomen and forearm of the patient
erythematous, infiltrating, well-demarcated skin lesions located on the face, chest, abdomen, and limbs
Mycological culture yielded growth of Trichophyton mentagrophytes
Images showing inflammatory lesions on the abdomen and forearm of the patient

concepts.why: The patient has erythematous, infiltrating, well-demarcated skin lesions and mycological culture yielded growth of Trichophyton mentagrophytes.
The patient has elevated eosinophils and IgE level, which suggests an allergic reaction.

aliases: Skin inflammation due to contact with an allergen or irritant
concepts.why: The patient has frequent contact with stray cats and has erythematous, infiltrating, well-demarcated skin lesions.
The patient has elevated inflammatory markers, such as erythrocyte sedimentation rate, C-reactive protein, and white blood cell count.

rationales.F04: Erythematous, infiltrating, well-demarcated skin lesions are characteristic of dermatological conditions.
rationales.F05: Contact with stray cats may suggest a zoonotic infection or allergic reaction.
rationales.F09: Elevated eosinophil count is often associated with eosinophilic dermatitis.
rationales.F10: High IgE levels can indicate an allergic reaction or immune-mediated condition.
rationales.F11: Mycological culture positive for Trichophyton mentagrophytes is diagnostic for dermatophytosis.

frontier_selector.rationale: Mycological culture yielded growth of Trichophyton mentagrophytes, which directly supports Dermatophytosis
